dm_conversations_inviter_check.name: dm_conversations_inviter_check
dm_conversations_inviter_check.value:
("dm_conversations"."invited_by" is null and "dm_conversations"."invite_status" = 'accepted') or
    ("dm_conversations"."invited_by" is not null and "dm_conversations"."invited_by" in ("dm_conversations"."first_user_id", "dm_conversations"."second_user_id"))

dm_devices_approval_check.name: dm_devices_approval_check
dm_devices_approval_check.value: ("dm_devices"."approved_by" is null) = ("dm_devices"."approval" is null) and (not "dm_devices"."root" or "dm_devices"."approved_by" is null)

dm_devices_revocation_check.name: dm_devices_revocation_check
dm_devices_revocation_check.value: ("dm_devices"."revoked_at" is null) = ("dm_devices"."revoked_by" is null) and ("dm_devices"."revoked_at" is null) = ("dm_devices"."revocation" is null)

notifications_subject_check.name: notifications_subject_check
notifications_subject_check.value:
case
        when "notifications"."kind"::text in ('dm_invite', 'dm_message') then "notifications"."conversation_id" is not null and "notifications"."post_id" is null
        when "notifications"."kind"::text in ('follow', 'friend') then "notifications"."conversation_id" is null and "notifications"."post_id" is null
        else "notifications"."conversation_id" is null and "notifications"."post_id" is not null
      end

posts_quote_check.name: posts_quote_check
posts_quote_check.value: ("posts"."is_quote" OR "posts"."quoted_post_id" IS NULL) AND (NOT "posts"."is_quote" OR "posts"."parent_id" IS NULL)

posts_content_check.name: posts_content_check
posts_content_check.value: char_length("posts"."content") <= 2000 AND ("posts"."content" ~ '[^[:space:]]' OR ("posts"."content" = '' AND ("posts"."gif" IS NOT NULL OR "posts"."poll" IS NOT NULL OR "posts"."voice" IS NOT NULL OR cardinality("posts"."image_ids") > 0)))
